Title: Using Maneuvers or Presses in Rounds Other Than When You Gain Them

Messages.Author: prestonp
Messages.Body: Darkness Within at superior, as well as other cards, give you a maneuver but don't specify that it must be used that round. Presumably I can use them in following rounds, correct?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
By default, combat cards effects last only until the end of the round during which they are played (rulebook).

An optional maneuver or press gained during a round must be used during that round, or be lost.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Now that the rulebook and the rulings are back online, here's the ruling:

www.vekn.net/index.php/general-rulings

> By default, combat cards only apply to the round in which they are played. Explicit card text is needed to overcome this default.  [RTR 19980623]
